# durantic_secrets_backend (Resource)

Manages a Durantic secrets backend — an external secrets store (Vault, HTTP) that supplies secrets to workloads.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Minimal example — HTTP secrets backend
resource "durantic_secrets_backend" "minimal" {
  name         = "my-secrets-backend"
  backend_type = "http"
  url          = "https://secrets.example.com"
}

# Full example — HashiCorp Vault backend with configuration
resource "durantic_secrets_backend" "vault" {
  name         = "production-vault"
  backend_type = "vault"
  url          = "https://vault.example.com"
  enabled      = true
  ca_cert      = file("vault-ca.pem")

  config = {
    auth_path  = "auth/approle"
    mount_path = "secret"
    role_id    = var.vault_role_id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backend_type` (String) Type of the secrets backend. Supported values: `vault`, `http`.
- `name` (String) Name of the secrets backend.
- `url` (String) URL of the secrets backend endpoint.

### Optional

- `ca_cert` (String) PEM-encoded CA certificate used to verify the backend's TLS certificate.
- `config` (Map of String) Backend-specific string key/value configuration (e.g. auth paths, mount paths).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the secrets backend is enabled.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the secrets backend was created.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the secrets backend was last updated.
- `uuid` (String) Unique identifier for the secrets backend.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/bash
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

terraform import durantic_secrets_backend.example <UUID>
```
